resources.string: Occasionally blocks something you wanted. Easy to allow again from the Log screen.
Expect to allow domains by hand.
This list blocks the endpoints VPN, proxy and private-DNS apps connect to — including the ones you chose. Turn it on only if you do not use any of them.

Banks, brokerages and card issuers use device fingerprinting to approve a login. Blocking it usually shows as an app that spins forever or logs you straight back out, with nothing to connect it to an ad blocker.
Deferred deep links are how a shared link opens the right screen. Blocking them shows as a blank screen or an onboarding loop.
On: adds this list to the blocklist.
On: stops protecting these domains, and lets your blocklists block them.
Analytics endpoints your phone\'s own system apps report to. Chosen automatically from this device\'s brand.
Around 369,000 hosts known for malware, phishing and scams. Large, and updated aggressively, so a legitimate site occasionally lands on it.
Around 54,000 hosts behind pop-ups, pop-unders and forced redirects.
Around 114,000 adult sites. This is a content filter, not an ad filter.
Link shorteners are used for tracking, and also for perfectly ordinary links. Expect the occasional dead link.
TikTok\'s analytics endpoints. The app itself keeps working; some in-app links may not.
Useful if this device syncs with a Microsoft account or runs Office apps.
Blocks the endpoints apps use to route DNS around this filter. It cannot tell yours from theirs.
Nullroute normally protects these domains so your bank can verify the device. They are trackers, and other blocklists block them.
Nullroute normally protects these so shared links open the right screen in delivery and ride-hailing apps. They are trackers, and other blocklists block them.
